description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Warden of the Eye and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Warden of the Eye tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing a Warden of the Eye token, adding an amount of {B} equal to its mana value. 
Repeat.
